title: Show HN: Mini-AGI – Dynamic continual learning model trained on 8GB VRAM
summary: Mini-AGI is a lightweight AGI prototype implementing dynamic continual learning, optimized to run on consumer GPUs with only 8GB VRAM. The project showcases promising scaling law results and aims to democratize access to advanced AI capabilities through efficient resource utilization.
problem_solved: Enables running AGI-like models on consumer-grade hardware instead of expensive high-end GPU clusters
why_valuable: Democratizes access to cutting-edge AI research by reducing hardware requirements from expensive multi-GPU setups to single consumer GPUs
